FN-PF1URRG-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 144
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Sponsor: Senator Coleman-Madison
Development
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 144 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners
in Psychology until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
